card.name: Reminder and caution phrasing
card.fires_on: The word "possibility" after "consider the" in overdose or pregnancy advice, and "forget" after "don't". It marks a caution or reminder phrase.

modes.label: The phrase "consider the possibility"
modes.description: "possibility" after "consider the" in overdose management or pregnancy advice, usually before "of multiple drug involvement".
modes.example: In managing overdosage, consider the<< possibility>> of multiple drug involvement.

modes.label: The phrase "don't forget"
modes.description: "forget" after "don't" in a reminder to do a step.
modes.example: 4jrdAL9MH0K. If you use the dbmmanage utility with your Apache web server to create passwords and usernames, don't<< forget>> to include in your /etc/httpd

modes.label: The reminder about checking labels
modes.description: A noun in a reminder instruction to check something before use.
modes.example: Always check insulin<< labels>> before administration.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that open a warning or reminder, such as "beware" or "be careful" in Chinese phrases.
card.plain: It responds to the word that opens a reminder or caution, like "consider the possibility" or "don't forget".
